## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-fascicle Tang-dynasty edited and supplemented version of **Zhìyǐ's** *Púsàjiè yìshū* ([KR6k0078](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0078)) by the Tiāntái scholastic **Míngkuàng** 明曠 ([明曠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%98%8E%E6%9B%A0)). 刪補 *shānbǔ* "edited and supplemented" indicates the redactional method.

**Abstract**

Míngkuàng's revised commentary represents the **mid-Tang Tiāntái scholastic consensus** on the bodhisattva-precepts. The work systematises Zhìyǐ's expository teaching, supplements it with intervening Tang-period scholarship (notably [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng's *Fànwǎngjīng púsàjièběn shū* ([KR6k0080](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0080)) Huayan reading), and presents a synthesised Tiāntái interpretation that became the working text of the Tang–Sòng Tiāntái tradition.
